captureKind: public API observation summary transcribed from tool output, not a byte-for-byte response archive
query: Northwind Customers n inner join Chinook Customer c on n.Country = c.Country; group by n.Country; select country, count(distinct n.CustomerID) as northwindCustomers, count(distinct c.CustomerId) as chinookCustomers; order by n.Country; limit 100
caveats: Exact shared country labels only. UK and United Kingdom are not normalized. Null countries and source-exclusive labels are excluded. Separate bounded source observations included two Northwind null-country records; their provenance was not determined and source contents may change.
acceptance: This proves server capability only. Local built-app browser acceptance is a separate Playwright receipt; root deployed UI acceptance remains pending landing.
